# Go and Kotlin run a sngl:sql statement: a target in another language
# refuses the program before its generator has nothing to write for it, a
# statement in an imported package's function included. Android carries
# SQLite alone, and refuses a program written for another engine.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

! sngl generate --platform=html -o out app.sngl
stderr 'the program queries a database, which html/none cannot yet: only the Go targets and android can'

! sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=c -o out app.sngl
stderr 'which gtk4/c cannot yet'

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea -o out app.sngl

sngl generate --platform=android -o out app.sngl
exists out/SnglSql.kt

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea -o out2 pg.sngl

! sngl generate --platform=android -o out2 pg.sngl
stderr 'the program queries postgresql, and android/kotlin reaches SQLite alone'

-- app.sngl --
import db "sql:./lite/sqlc.yaml"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var n int64 = 0
    ui.button(text="Count", @click {
        match var c = db.countCall() {
            ok { n = c }
            failed { n = -1 }
        }
    })
    ui.text(value="{n}")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- pg.sngl --
import db "sql:./pg/sqlc.yaml"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var n int64 = 0
    ui.button(text="Count", @click {
        match var c = db.countCall() {
            ok { n = c }
            failed { n = -1 }
        }
    })
    ui.text(value="{n}")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- lite/sqlc.yaml --
version: "2"
sql:
  - engine: sqlite
    schema: schema.sql
    queries: query.sql
-- lite/schema.sql --
CREATE TABLE a (id INTEGER NOT NULL);
-- lite/query.sql --
-- name: Count :one
SELECT count(*) FROM a;
-- pg/sqlc.yaml --
version: "2"
sql:
  - engine: postgresql
    schema: schema.sql
    queries: query.sql
-- pg/schema.sql --
CREATE TABLE a (id bigint NOT NULL);
-- pg/query.sql --
-- name: Count :one
SELECT count(*) FROM a;
